newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Robinson's Land FY 96/97 seen up 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Robinson's Land FY 96/97 seen up 50 pct.

text.p: Robinson's Land Corp is expected to post over 50 percent increase in net income for fiscal year 1996/97 ending September 30, company officers said on Wednesday.
"We expect over 50 percent rise in net income in the current fiscal year from the previous 600.11 million pesos," president James Go told reporters after the company's annual shareholders meeting.
Robinson's Land is investing three billion pesos this year on its hotel and mass housing expansion, Go said.
Robinsons Land is a unit of JG Summit Holdings Inc.

Asked if Robinsons Land could be affected by the confidence crisis in the property sector, JG Summit chairman John Gokongwei said: "We don't owe anybody money. If anything goes wrong of if the industry collapses, we have nothing to lose."
